patterns.note: Sections alternate between full-width content blocks and those with a central, constrained content column, often featuring large, detailed product UI mockups or illustrations.
Headings are consistently large, bold, and sans-serif, creating a strong visual hierarchy, complemented by smaller, often uppercase, labels for sub-sections or categories.

The site primarily uses a high-contrast palette of white backgrounds and dark text, punctuated by a distinct blue for CTAs and interactive elements, and occasional dark background sections for emphasis.

The top promotional banner disappears on scroll, and the main navigation bar transforms from transparent to sticky with a solid white background and subtle shadow as the user scrolls down the page. Content sections simply scroll into view without complex animations.
Many sections feature large, embedded, and highly detailed product UI screenshots or mockups that serve as primary visual content, directly illustrating the platform's functionality.

technique_notes: The hero section is designed to accommodate a video background, providing dynamic visual interest behind the main headline and call-to-action.

A global navigation bar is initially transparent and overlays the hero content, then transitions to a fixed, sticky position at the top of the viewport with a solid background and subtle drop shadow upon scrolling.
Content sections are revealed sequentially as the user scrolls down the page, appearing to slide up into view without complex staggered animations or parallax effects.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with clear, readable body text and smaller, often uppercase, labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on buttons, cards, and input fields.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density overall; the hero section is airy, while feature grids and resource cards are more dense but well-organized.

standout: The site's standout feature is its extensive and high-quality use of detailed, realistic product UI mockups and illustrations, which are integrated directly into content sections to visually demonstrate complex features and workflows rather than relying solely on text descriptions.
